articles.title: Paul McCartney e Mick Jagger prestam homenagens a Dolly Parton; veja | G1
articles.standfirst: Paul McCartney, Jane Fonda e Mick Jagger prestam homenagens. Lenda da música country morreu nesta terça-feira, aos 80 anos.
articles.summary: Paul McCartney, Jane Fonda e Mick Jagger prestam homenagens. Lenda da música country morreu nesta terça-feira, aos 80 anos.
articles.body:
Lenda da música country, a cantora e atriz Dolly Parton morreu nesta terça (25) , aos 80 anos. A informação foi confirmada pela família em um vídeo nas redes sociais.

Conhecida pela voz marcante, pelas perucas loiras e figurinos extravagantes, Dolly construiu um império no entretenimento a partir de suas origens humildes no estado americano do Tennessee.

Eleita para os Halls da Fama do Country e do Rock & Roll e vencedora de 10 prêmios Grammy, Parton expandiu sua atuação para além da música country, transitando pelo pop, bluegrass e pela era disco.

Artistas, colegas do gênero e outros famosas lamentaram a morte. Veja abaixo:

Dolly Parton se apresenta em Tóquio, em julho de 1979 — Foto: AP Photo/Tsugufumi Matsumoto, Arquivo

"Estou devastada. Acabei de saber que Dolly se foi. Sei que milhões estão de luto e quero dizer o seguinte: mais do que qualquer pessoa que já conheci, Dolly sempre estará conosco, porque ela era tão presente, tão poderosa, tão generosa e divertida que está entrelaçada em todas as nossas vidas e corações para sempre. Temos nossas memórias dela, suas músicas, Dollywood, "Como eliminar seu chefe", os milhões de livros que ela colocou nas mãos de crianças, todas as imagens icônicas que a trazem até nós. E tudo isso são bênçãos. Sejamos gratos por tudo o que ela nos deixou para aliviar nossa tristeza agora. Eu nunca conheci ninguém como ela. Ela era simultaneamente uma garota sulista travessa e divertida dos vales do Tennessee e uma pensadora profunda e sensível, capaz de enxergar as pessoas até o fundo de sua verdadeira essência. Ela era muitas coisas… letrista, cantora, multi-instrumentista, escritora, piadista, visionária, amiga leal, que nunca ia dormir antes de ela e suas amigas rirem tanto a ponto de precisarem cruzar as pernas.

Ela tinha o instinto de uma sobrevivente e parecia sempre saber exatamente o que fazer, exatamente o que dizer para consertar as coisas... e logo em seguida colocava a bunda para fora da janela do carro e mostrava o traseiro para a casa de Kenny Rogers. Ela era a personificação voluptuosa da empatia. Isso é algo dela que ela gostaria que todos nós levássemos conosco.

Aos seus fãs gays e trans, quero que saibam que ela amava vocês. Vocês sabem disso sem que eu precise dizer. Ela amava todos os seus fãs, e eles são uma legião. E vocês sabem que ela não iria querer ver vocês de luto agora. Vistam-se com estilo e celebrem seu espírito. Mas antes, assistam ao episódio final de 'Grace and Frankie', onde ela interpreta um Anjo, a chefe dos anjos da classe trabalhadora no Céu.

Descanse em paz, mulher linda. Nós te amamos."

"A magnífica estrela Dolly Parton morreu, e isso é muito triste. Ela era uma mulher maravilhosa. Eu a conheci em Nashville, no Grand Ole Opry, onde ela vinha se apresentando com o astro da música country Porter Wagoner e estava prestes a iniciar sua carreira solo. Ela era tão radiante e cheia de vida que é difícil assimilar a notícia de sua partida. Suas composições, seu canto e sua filantropia eram incomparáveis no mundo da música country, e é difícil imaginar viver em um mundo sem Dolly. Ela era uma mulher de negócios inteligentíssima, que entendia o valor de sua música e, o mais importante, o impacto que exercia sobre as pessoas em todo o mundo. Não houve honra maior para mim do que tê-la cantando minha música 'Let It Be' e, mesmo tendo feito apenas uma pequena contribuição nela, sinto-me muito honrado por ela ter feito isso. Tenho muito orgulho de tê-la conhecido e admiro seus talentos únicos. Obrigado, Dolly, pela linda música que você deu a mim e ao mundo inteiro. Nós sempre amaremos você, que Deus a abençoe e descanse em paz. Você foi a melhor."

Mick Jagger, vocalista dos Rolling Stones

"Que compositora e cantora incrível que Dolly era. Ela reuniu tantas pessoas. Vamos sentir muito a sua falta."

"Ah, Dolly. A única coisa que consegui dizer depois de nos encontrarmos pela primeira vez foi: 'ela realmente é um anjo caminhando na terra' e 'parece até que poderíamos ser irmãs'. Guardarei com carinho nossas risadas e conversas, e vou manter a sua sabedoria, sua visão bem-humorada da vida e seu senso de humor impecável no meu bolso para os dias difíceis. Nunca haverá outra igual a você, e quanta sorte todos nós tivemos de presenciar a sua magia singular, assim como sua voz, suas canções e seu coração únicos. A sua luz será algo que o mundo procurará para sempre para reencontrar. Eu sempre vou te amar."

"Bem, acabei de receber a notícia de que minha grande amiga Dolly partiu para um plano superior e maior. Dolly, obrigado por todas as coisas maravilhosas que você fez por nós aqui na Terra. Seu amor, sua música e tudo o que você doou com seu coração enorme, enorme. Nunca, jamais haverá outra como você. Nós vamos lembrar e guardar com carinho cada memória e cada nota que você já tocou e cantou. Obrigado, Senhor, pela Dolly. Ela vai se divertir muito no céu cantando todas as suas músicas favoritas com toda a sua família e amigos que partiram antes dela. Nunca vou esquecer a primeira vez que te conheci e nunca vou esquecer a nossa última conversa. Eu a guardo com amor no meu coração. Eu sempre vou te amar, Reba."

Julia Roberts, atriz, em comunicado à revista 'Variety'

"Dolly era um ser humano mágico e alegre. Ter a oportunidade de conhecê-la é um tesouro que guardo na minha vida. O sol brilha menos hoje."

"Sinto tanto ao saber da Dolly — ela era uma força da natureza. Que descanse em paz."

"Dizem para nunca conhecer seus heróis. Eles estavam errados sobre ela. A coragem de saber que ela era mais do que achavam e que precisava se libertar e seguir em frente rumo a novos trabalhos e novas possibilidades a levou a escrever 'I ill always love you', como sua forma de agradecer e amar, mas seguir em frente. Ela é um grande exemplo para todos nós."

"Certamente, sentirei falta de seu riso, suas piadas e seu ser. Descanse bem e em paz total, minha amiga. Meu coração está pesado."

"Nunca conheci a Dolly Parton, mas, meu Deus, como eu a amava. Acho que nenhum de nós precisava conhecê-la para amá-la. Uma das maiores que este país já produziu. Lenda. De verdade. Para sempre. E sempre defendendo aqueles que ela sabia e compreendia que precisavam de um defensor. Que perda. Mas não somos tão sortudos, tão afortunados pelos presentes infinitos que ela compartilhou com o mundo. Vá em paz e descanse em paz. Você fará uma falta terrível."

"Dolly nos ensinou que você pode ser tudo e fazer tudo e a fazê-lo com gentileza. Que luz. Somos todos gratos por termos vividos na época de Dolly Parton. Sempre vamos amá-la."

"Dolly Parton tinha um jeito de fazer todo mundo se sentir especial, visto, acolhido e como se fossem velhos amigos. Sentirei falta do coração e da voz dela, assim como tenho certeza de que milhões sentirão. Que presente e talento incríveis ela foi e continua sendo, com um catálogo de arte formidável que deixou para todos nós.""

"Se realmente existem anjos na terra, acabamos de perder um. Dolly Parton. Nunca haverá outra igual. Eu a adorava com todo o meu coração e sempre guardarei com carinho o tempo que passamos juntos. Para sempre. Descanse em paz, linda Dolly."

"Chocado e devastado ao saber da morte de Dolly. Uma artista gigante — única e insubstituível, com o coração mais gentil."

"Sempre haverá só uma Dolly Parton. Que alma ela tinha."

"Dolly Parton tinha um jeito de fazer todo mundo se sentir especial, visto, acolhido e como se fossem velhos amigos. Sentirei falta do coração e da voz dela, assim como tenho certeza de que milhões sentirão. Que presente e talento incríveis ela foi e continua sendo, com um catálogo de arte formidável que deixou para todos nós.""

"Se realmente existem anjos na terra, acabamos de perder um. Dolly Parton. Nunca haverá outra igual. Eu a adorava com todo o meu coração e sempre guardarei com carinho o tempo que passamos juntos. Para sempre. Descanse em paz, linda Dolly."
"Chocado e devastado ao saber da morte de Dolly. Uma artista gigante — única e insubstituível, com o coração mais gentil."

articles.title: Dolly Parton, lenda da música country, morre aos 80 anos  | G1
articles.standfirst: Ela foi eleita para os Halls da Fama do Country e do Rock & Roll e ganhou 10 prêmios no Grammy. Informação foi revelada pelo sobrinho da cantora nas redes sociais.
articles.summary: Ela foi eleita para os Halls da Fama do Country e do Rock & Roll e ganhou 10 prêmios no Grammy. Informação foi revelada pelo sobrinho da cantora nas redes sociais.
articles.body:
Lenda da música country, a cantora e atriz Dolly Parton morreu nesta terça (25), aos 80 anos. A informação foi confirmada pela família em um vídeo nas redes sociais.

"Esse anúncio em vídeo é algo que Dolly me pediu há anos, antes que eu tivesse absorvido totalmente como uma realidade no futuro", disse Bryan Seaver, sobrinho e chefe da segurança da cantora.

"A tristeza fica conosco, não com a Dolly. Dolly viveu na luz e está nos braços de Jesus, com certeza, ao lado de Carl [Thomas Dean, seu marido, que morreu em 2025], seus pais e incontáveis outros que a assistiram e que queriam encontrá-la nos céus."

Em último vídeo nas redes sociais, Dolly Parton convidou para exposição sobre sua vida; veja

Relembre história de 'Jolene', clássico da cantora que ganhou versão de Beyoncé

"Dolly também abriu as portas para gerações de cantores, compositores, músicos e sonhadores de todos os campos da vida e de todos os continentes. Com seu exemplo, nós acreditamos que tudo era possível. Ela nunca viu uma porta que não pudesse abrir, e as portas que ela abriu fizeram e mudaram a história."

Dolly enfrentava problemas de saúde desde a morte do marido, Carl Dean, que morreu em março de 2025. Ela cancelou uma residência de shows em maio deste ano. Em entrevista à revista "People", publicada no dia 21, ela disse que "não prestou atenção [aos próprios problemas]" enquanto cuidava do marido.

"Mas ainda estou trabalhando e há muitas coisas que eu ainda quero conquistar", acrescentou.

Conhecida pela voz marcante, pelas perucas loiras e por seus figurinos extravagantes, Dolly construiu um império no entretenimento a partir de suas origens humildes no estado americano do Tennessee.

Com mais de 3 mil músicas em seu catálogo, a artista se consolidou como um ícone da cultura pop e expandiu sua atuação para além da música country, transitando pelo pop, bluegrass e pela era disco.

Sua trajetória na música e no cinema se tornou parte do cânone da cultura americana. Ao longo de sua carreira, Dolly compôs sucessos atemporais que se tornaram clássicos, regravados por artistas do calibre de Beyoncé e Tina Turner. São dela músicas como "Jolene", "9 to 5" e "Coat of Many Colors".

Também foi Dolly quem escreveu e lançou a balada romântica "I Will Always Love You", posteriormente gravada por Whitney Houston para o filme "O Guarda-Costas".

Dolly Parton durante evento em Nova York, em outubro de 2022 — Foto: AP Photo/Andres Kudacki, Arquivo

Nascida em 1946 em Sevier County, em uma cabana de apenas um cômodo às margens do rio Little Pigeon, Dolly era a quarta de 12 filhos de um agricultor sem terras. A família não tinha acesso a água encanada ou eletricidade, e o médico que atendeu seu parto foi pago com um saco de farinha de milho.

Foi no ambiente familiar, marcado por hinos e canções folclóricas ensinadas pela mãe, que ela aprendeu a tocar instrumentos como violão e banjo, fazendo suas primeiras apresentações no rádio ainda na infância e lançando seu primeiro compacto em 1959.

O primeiro grande avanço em sua carreira ocorreu em 1967, ao ser contratada para o programa de televisão do cantor Porter Wagoner. A parceria na TV rendeu diversos hits em dueto, mas a crescente popularidade solo de Dolly acabou superando a do parceiro.

Ao decidir deixar o programa para focar na carreira solo em 1974, ela compôs "I Will Always Love You" como uma homenagem de despedida. A faixa alcançou o topo da parada country duas vezes antes de se tornar um fenômeno pop na voz de Whitney Houston, em 1992.

Ao longo de mais de seis décadas de trajetória, a artista escreveu cerca de 3 mil músicas. Suas composições abordavam temas cotidianos com olhar empático e socialmente crítico, tratando da infância pobre em "Coat of Many Colors", da gravidez na adolescência em "Down From Dover" e do machismo no mercado de trabalho em "9 to 5", canção-tema do filme homônimo lançado em 1980 no qual ela também atuou ao lado de Jane Fonda e Lily Tomlin.

Lily Tomlin, Dolly Parton e Jane Fonda em '9 to 5' — Foto: Reprodução

Entre seus maiores sucessos nas paradas estão a colaboração com Kenny Rogers em "Islands in the Stream" (1983) e o aclamado projeto "Trio", gravado ao lado de Emmylou Harris e Linda Ronstadt. A artista também construiu um império empresarial no Tennessee com o parque temático Dollywood e investiu na indústria cinematográfica e na televisão.

Com 55 indicações ao Grammy e 10 vitórias, Parton também foi a terceira mulher mais indicada na história do Grammy, atrás apenas de Beyoncé e Taylor Swift.

Dolly não tinha medo de inovar ou experimentar em seu trabalho, o que a garantiu essa carreira tão versátil e duradoura.

“Eu não tinha medo de mudar. Eu esperava o sucesso, mas estava preparada para o fracasso. Não me importava se as pessoas achassem que eu estava errada. No fundo, eu sabia que estava fazendo a coisa certa", disse à Associated Press em 1979.

Eleita para os Halls da Fama do Country e do Rock & Roll, Dolly Parton também se destacou pela atuação filantrópica. Por meio da fundação Imagination Library, criada em 1995, ela distribuiu mais de 200 milhões de livros para crianças.

Defensora ativa da diversidade e da inclusão, a cantora aliou seu trabalho social a posicionamentos públicos acolhedores, tornando-se uma figura de apelo universal na música norte-americana.

Nas últimas décadas, conquistou novas gerações ao trabalhar com artistas como Miley Cyrus, de quem era madrinha, Sabrina Carpenter e Beyoncé.

articles.title: Após cancelar turnê, Xamã lança álbum, 'Flerte', em que canta com Ludmilla, NP Vocal, L7nnon, Amabii e Nomad | G1
articles.body:
Capa do álbum 'Flerte', de Xamã — Foto: Divulgação

♬ Duas semanas após ter cancelado, às vésperas da estreia, uma turnê que previa mais de 30 shows em 25 cidades do Brasil, Xamã se prepara para apresentar o quinto álbum de estúdio do artista, intitulado “Flerte” e programado para ser lançado na quinta-feira, 27 de agosto.

“Foram onze meses construindo esse universo com recortes de poesias escritas no bloco de notas, músicas regravadas, pessoas e texturas que fizeram esse desejo ganhar forma”, relatou o cantor e compositor carioca ao revelar a capa e a contracapa – esta com a tracklist – do álbum “Flerte”.

Além dos já conhecidos feats com Ludmilla (em “Moça”) e L7nnon (em “Tá de parabéns”), faixas lançadas em julho e em março, respectivamente, o álbum “Flerte” traz as músicas “Bagunçou minha sexta”, “Like a Michael”, “Meu sonho é tu”, “Chá de”, “Você tirou meu ar” e “A nova sagitariana”, totalizando oito faixas.

Três delas – “A nova sagitariana”, “Chá de” e “Você tirou meu ar”– trazem a rapper paulistana Amabii (artista que transita entre o rap e o R&B) e o rapper NP Vocal. O carioca Nomad se junta a Amabii e a NP Vocal em “Chá de”.

A produção musical do álbum “Flerte” foi orquestrada por Ramon Calixto, $amuka e Marcio Arantes.

Contracapa do álbum 'Flerte', de Xamã — Foto: Divulgação

articles.title: Dolly Parton morreu após tratamento recente contra câncer | G1
articles.standfirst: Lenda da música country morreu nesta terça-feira (25). Cantora foi eleita para os Halls da Fama do Country e do Rock & Roll e ganhou 10 prêmios no Grammy.
articles.summary: A lenda da música country e vencedora de 10 Grammys morreu nesta terça-feira (25), deixando um legado histórico na cultura pop e na filantropia mundial.
articles.body:
Dolly Parton, lenda da música country que morreu nesta terça-feira (25) aos 80 anos , passava por tratamento contra um câncer. A informação foi revelada por assessores da cantora em um comunicado à revista "People".

"Nossa amada Dolly Parton passou sua vida e sua carreira trazendo alegria, risada, esperança e integridade a tudo o que tocou. Sua generosidade sem igual alcançou as vidas de incontáveis pessoas às quais ela nunca conheceu, mas ela sempre esteve presente para oferecer a mão", afirmaram.

"Seja por meio das centenas de milhões de livros doados por sua inestimável (ONG) Imagination Library ou pelo financiamento de pesquisas que ajudaram a criar uma vacina que salvou vidas ao redor do mundo, o amor incondicional de Dolly por todas as pessoas foi a força motriz de seu impacto duradouro. Após enfrentar com bravura uma breve batalha contra o câncer, Dolly partiu de sua vida terrena hoje, no Vanderbilt-Ingram Cancer Center, cercada por entes queridos."

Dolly Parton durante evento em Nova York, em outubro de 2022 — Foto: AP Photo/Andres Kudacki, Arquivo

A morte da cantora foi anunciada em um vídeo gravado por seu sobrinho, e chefe de segurança, Bryan Seaver.

"A tristeza fica conosco, não com a Dolly. Dolly viveu na luz e está nos braços de Jesus, com certeza, ao lado de Carl [Thomas Dean, seu marido, que morreu em 2025], seus pais e incontáveis outros que a assistiram e que queriam encontrá-la nos céus", afirmou ele.

"Dolly também abriu as portas para gerações de cantores, compositores, músicos e sonhadores de todos os campos da vida e de todos os continentes. Com seu exemplo, nós acreditamos que tudo era possível. Ela nunca viu uma porta que não pudesse abrir, e as portas que ela abriu fizeram e mudaram a história."

Dolly enfrentava problemas de saúde desde a morte do marido, Carl Dean, que morreu em março de 2025. Ela cancelou uma residência de shows em maio deste ano. Em entrevista à revista "People", publicada no dia 21, ela disse que "não prestou atenção [aos próprios problemas]" enquanto cuidava do marido.

Conhecida pela voz marcante, pelas perucas loiras e por seus figurinos extravagantes, Dolly construiu um império no entretenimento a partir de suas origens humildes no estado americano do Tennessee.

Com mais de 3 mil músicas em seu catálogo, a artista se consolidou como um ícone da cultura pop e expandiu sua atuação para além da música country, transitando pelo pop, bluegrass e pela era disco.

Sua trajetória na música e no cinema se tornou parte do cânone da cultura americana. Ao longo de sua carreira, Dolly compôs sucessos atemporais que se tornaram clássicos, regravados por artistas do calibre de Beyoncé e Tina Turner. São dela músicas como "Jolene", "9 to 5" e "Coat of Many Colors".

Também foi Dolly quem escreveu e lançou a balada romântica "I Will Always Love You", posteriormente gravada por Whitney Houston para o filme "O Guarda-Costas".

articles.title: Inside Jaaved Jaaferiâs 7,000-sq-ft sea-facing Bandra home with Mediterranean design, earthy interiors, textured walls, family memories and breathtaking Arabian Sea views
articles.summary: For veteran actor and television personality Jaaved Jaaferi, home has always meant Bandra. The actor graciously recently opened the doors of his over .
articles.body: For veteran actor and television personality Jaaved Jaaferi, home has always meant Bandra. The actor graciously recently opened the doors of his over 7,000-square-foot sea-facing apartment, walking Architectural Digest through a thoughtful space that reflects both his personal history and his family's evolving lifestyle needs. Designed by Kush Bhayani of KULx Studio, the spacious home leans into a warm, Mediterranean aesthetic while weaving in decades of memories from Jaaved's life in the suburb.Jaaved Jafferi's return to Bandra, rooted in nostalgiaJaaved's move back to Bandra wasn't just about the address but was deeply personal. "I've been a Bandra boy all my life; I was here for 40 years," Jaaved shares, recalling how he split his childhood and early years between his first two homes in the suburb before eventually moving to Lokhandwala with his children.The decision to return was also influenced by his elder children, Meezaan and Alaviaa. While Jaaved once found Bandra's dense construction overwhelming, this particular apartment changed his mind instantly. His brief to designer Kush Bhayani was simple: minimal sophistication, described in three words â "Warm, natural, eclectic."The new residence consequently became a way of reconnecting with familiar surroundings while creating a contemporary family home.What does Jaaved Jafferi's home look like?Overlooking the Arabian Sea, the apartment is designed around earthy, sunbaked tones that give it an instantly calming quality. The living room is anchored by a sage-toned two-sided sofa, while plush, earth-toned furnishings and pops of green create a soothing, lived-in atmosphere. The interiors draw heavily from Mediterranean influences, with earthy shades and natural materials running throughout the apartment. The expansive living room features plush, earth-toned furnishings, complemented by green accents that give the space a calm and soothing character.Textured micro-concrete walls run through the entire home, a detail the whole family agrees on. Patterned rugs, cured wood logs and translucent stone surfaces add to the eclectic, rustic-meets-modern feel, while a cosy reading nook with a built-in bookshelf houses artefacts from the family's travels and an extensive DVD collection.The dining table and family spaces at Jaaved Jafferi's homeOne addition the family was especially keen on was a proper dining table, something increasingly rare in homes shaped by social media and OTT habits. Meezaan explains the shift it's brought about at home, noting that everyone now gathers to eat together instead of retreating to their rooms with their meals. The dining area features a sleek onyx slab table supported by wooden logs, paired with upholstered chairs, and lit by bespoke sculptural fabric pendant lamps.A long terrace serves as another favourite spot, where two generations of the family come together to talk and unwind. Alaviaa's room, meanwhile, stands out with rust-maroon and colourful accents against the home's earthy base, including a statement chair and a sinuous mirror.A reading nook filled with family memoriesThe apartment also makes space for Jaaved's love of nostalgia. A cosy reading corner incorporates a built-in bookshelf filled with artefacts collected during the family's travels, along with an extensive DVD collection. Objects bearing personal significance have been integrated into the interiors. The family's shared history is similarly reflected in Meezaan's collection of CDs, featuring artists such as Don McLean and Fleetwood Mac. articles.summary: âBatwara 1947â continued its slow run at the box office on its second Monday. The Sunny Deol starrer clashed at the box office with Emraan Hashmi's 'A.
articles.body: âBatwara 1947â continued its slow run at the box office on its second Monday. The Sunny Deol starrer clashed at the box office with Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' on Independence day and the latter is in a completely different league. The Emraan Hashmi starrer had already collected Rs. 136.25 crore net in India by Day 10 while 'Batwara 1947' continues to struggle to touch Rs 40 crore at the box office.The Rajkumar Santoshi directorial opened with Rs 5.75 crore on Day 1 and saw a big jump to Rs 13.50 crore on Day 2. It then collected Rs 7.25 crore on Day 3 before falling to Rs 2 crore on the first Monday. The film ended its opening week with Rs 33.60 crore.The second weekend did not bring much improvement. âBatwara 1947â earned Rs 75 lakh on the second Friday, followed by Rs 1.15 crore on Saturday and Rs 1.30 crore on Sunday.On Monday, day 11, the film has made a negligible amount of Rs 35 lakhs and now the total India net stands at Rs 37.15 crore. The India gross total is Rs 44 crore while the worldwide collection is Rs 53 crore.This means âAwarapan 2â has earned nearly Rs. 100 crore more than âBatwara 1947â in India net collections by the end of Day 11. While âAwarapan 2â is racing towards the Rs 150 crore milestone, âBatwara 1947â is struggling to maintain momentum and is heading towards an underwhelming theatrical run.With this, one can expect the end of the film's run at the box office and reportedly made on a budget of Rs 120 crore, 'Batwara 1947' will suffer a loss and the film unfortunately has failed to meet expectations.The contrast is especially notable considering both films arrived around the Independence Day period. While âAwarapan 2â has benefited from strong word of mouth and sustained audience interest, âBatwara 1947â has failed to turn its initial weekend momentum into a long-lasting box office run.Day wise collections for 'Batwara 1947'Week 1: Rs. 33.60 croreDay 8: Rs. 0.75 croreDay 9 Rs 1.15CrDay 10 Rs 1.30CrDay 11 Rs 0.35CrOverall Total India Net Collection - Rs 37.15CrGive your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: 'Vishwanath and Sons' box office collections day 11 vs 'DC': Lokesh Kanagarajâs acting debut nears Rs 100 crore worldwide
articles.summary: After a successful ten-day run at the box office, Suriya and Mamitha Baiju's 'Vishwanath and Sons' continues to perform steadily. On its second Monday.
articles.body: After a successful ten-day run at the box office, Suriya and Mamitha Baiju's 'Vishwanath and Sons' continues to perform steadily. On its second Monday, the family drama added decent numbers to its total. Meanwhile, Lokesh Kanagaraj and Wamiqa Gabbi's starrer 'DC' recorded a decline in earnings on its third Monday.'Vishwanath and Sons' collectionsAs per Sacnilk, 'Vishwanath and Sons' made over Rs 2.05 crore on its second Monday, seeing a decline of 71.9% from its Sunday collection. The film had 3,953 shows with an occupancy of 20.3%.The filmâs total net collections in India reached Rs 102.70 crore, while the total India gross collections stand at Rs 118.80 crore. Talking about its international market, 'Vishwanath and Sons' collected Rs 1.00 crore on Monday, bringing the total overseas gross to Rs 59 crore. The worldwide gross collection stands at Rs 177.80 crore.Both the Telugu and Tamil versions had a fair share of collection, as the Telugu version made Rs 90 lakh across 1,738 shows and the Tamil one made Rs 1.15 crore across 2,215 shows.Directed by Venky Atluri, it features Radikaa Sarathkumar, Raveena Tandon, Nassar, Sudha, Kalyani Natarajan, Raghu Babu, Sunil Reddy, Rajiv Menon, Bhavani Sri, Viva Harsha, Kaali Venkat, George Maryan, Hyper Aadhi, Srija Ravi and Sarvadaman Banerjee.âDCâ collectionsMeanwhile, Lokesh Kanagaraj and Wamiqa Gabbi starrer âDCâ saw a fall as it made over Rs 48 lakh on Day 18. It shows a decline of 67.1% from the previous day's collections, which was Rs 1.46 crore. On Monday, the film recorded 1,458 shows with an occupancy of 18.0%.The filmâs total net collections in India come to Rs 66.18 crore, while the total India gross collections stand at Rs 76.22 crore.The total worldwide gross collection stands at Rs 99.37 crore, inches close to hitting the Rs 100 crore mark.Occupancy of the filmsSpeaking of the filmâs occupancy, 'Vishwanath and Sons' had a total occupancy of 21.83%. The film began its run with 17.77% in the morning. It gradually increased, with afternoon shows recording 19.92%, evening shows reaching 21.54% occupancy, and finally peaking at night with 27.08%.On the other hand, âDCâ had an overall occupancy of 17.69%. The morning shows were at 12.92%, while they increased to 17.46% in the afternoon. Later, it saw a small dip, reaching 15.23% in the evening and completing the day with 23.08% at night.âDCâ marks the acting Telugu debut of renowned director Lokesh Kanagaraj. Directed by Arun Matheswaran, the film tells the story of Devadas and Chandra, giving meaning to the title DC. The film is a modern-day reimagining of the classic story âDevadasâ, but it is set in an action-filled world.DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources. All figures are approximate unless explicitly mentioned, offering a fair representation of the movie's box office performance. These totals may change as official studio data is updated or as additional international market reports are finalized. articles.title: Ester Expósito desvela por qué ya no hace escenas íntimas: "Hice suficientes en 'Élite"
articles.standfirst: La actriz explica que hay muchos proyectos en las que “hay escenas de sexo gratuitas”
articles.summary: Ester Expósito desvela por qué ya no hace escenas íntimas: "Hice suficientes en 'Élite"
articles.body: Ester Exposíto lleva años labrando una gran carrera como actriz. Una trayectoria que comenzó mucho antes de sus papeles en ‘Élite’. Su primera aparición en pantalla fue en la serie ‘Centro médico’. En la actualidad, ya es una de las actrices más reconocidas del panorama español. Tal y cómo explica en una conversación con Hugo Diego García organizada por GQ España, ese reconocimiento ha llevado a Ester a poder elegir o rechazar algunos proyectos por muchas razones, entre ellas, que considere que en el guion aparezcan ”muchas escenas de sexo gratuitas”. “Ya hice suficientes en ‘Élite’”, declara Expósito, “entiendo que era parte del producto, de cómo era, pero es verdad que luego decidí protegerme un poco más”. En la ficción juvenil de Netflix, los actores interpretaban a compañeros de instituto y se mostraban los comportamientos que se suelen tener en el ámbito privado a esa edad. “No hay nada de malo, porque al final en el cine o en la televisión retratamos la vida, y en la vida hay sexo, como también hay violencia”, explica la intérprete sobre la aparición de escenas íntimas en el cine. “No es que me niegue a tener escenas íntimas, pero sí que me niego a tenerlas cuando no son necesarias para contar la historia y son gratuitas o demasiadas”, concluye la actriz. Después Hugo le pregunta sobre cómo vive ella sus relaciones personales. “He tenido un proceso y un camino, porque yo creo un poco por la cosa que tenemos instaurada todavía del amor romántico y de que el amor duele”, comienza contestando Ester. “Mis relaciones siempre fueron un poco turbulentas. He tenido momentos felices, pero mis relaciones en el pasado siempre han sido muy intensas, muy dramáticas…”. Ahora, confiesa que ha madurado y que está en un momento muy feliz.

articles.title: Quote of the day by Woody Allen: âThe talent for being happy is appreciating and liking what you have, instead of what you donât have,' the âAnnie Hallâ starâs words on finding happiness in what you already have
articles.summary: Explore Woody Allen's profound quote on happiness and learn how appreciating what you already have can lead to a more fulfilling life. Discover his journey and career achievements in the entertainment industry.
articles.body: Woody Allen has been a well-known figure in the entertainment industry for years. The star dabbled in everything, ranging from acting to directing and writing. Todayâs quote about learning how to be satisfied with life and what you already have comes from a place of experience for Allen.The quote of the day by Woody Allen reads, "The talent for being happy is appreciating and liking what you have, instead of what you donât have.âWhat did Woody Allen mean by this quote?This quote is directly from the filmmaker and actorâs book titled âWoody Allen on Woody Allen: In Conversation with Stig BjÃ¶rkman.â The quote essentially says that it is important to appreciate what you already have, rather than focusing on what you do not. While it is human nature to appreciate things you have not yet achieved more, it often results in people forgetting the things they once worked hard to achieve.He acknowledges that one should never stop striving for success and goals; however, the key to success is remembering where you came fromâyour roots. When happiness is attached to what you don't have, the finish line keeps moving. Obtaining the missing piece simply creates a new desire, leaving you forever dissatisfied with life.At the end of the day, focusing on existing relationships, current health, or present comforts and things you have anchors you in the moment. It transforms routine aspects of life into sources of genuine joy and helps you understand that you need a balance of wanting more, while also appreciating what you already have.About Woody Allenâs early lifeHeywood âWoodyâ Allen (born Allan Stewart Konigsberg) was born in Brooklyn, New York, on December 1, 1935. His mother worked as a bookkeeper, while his father was a waiter and also engraved jewelry. Woody had humble beginnings and was from a middle-class family. Over the years, the filmmaker and actor has been open about how his relationship with his parents was strained and that he did not connect well enough with them. As a child, he immersed himself in the arts to escape his turbulent childhood. This included reading comic books, listening to jazz radio, doing magic tricks, and playing the clarinet.From an early age, he was interested in filmmaking and studied the subject at NYU (from where he later dropped out after failing a class) and City College of New York. He also legally changed his name to Heywood Allen when he was 17 and started calling himself by the nickname, âWoody.âWoody Allenâs careerHe started in the industry writing for âThe Herb Shriner Show,' after which he also wrote for âThe Tonight Showâ and âCandid Camera.' He received his first Grammy nomination for his self-titled comedy album. He dabbled in Broadway, working on âDon't Drink the Waterâ and âPlay It Again, Sam.â He entered the film industry as a screenwriter with âWhat's New, Pussycat?â and the rest is history. Over the years, he has worked as a scriptwriter, filmmaker, director, and actor. His first time as a director came with âWhat's Up, Tiger Lily.'Over the course of his career in the entertainment industry, Allen has scored more than 75 writing credits, along with over 50 directing credits and 50 acting credits.Give your child the gift of confidence! When happiness is attached to what you don't have, the finish line keeps moving. Obtaining the missing piece simply creates a new desire, leaving you forever dissatisfied with life.At the end of the day, focusing on existing relationships, current health, or present comforts and things you have anchors you in the moment. It transforms routine aspects of life into sources of genuine joy and helps you understand that you need a balance of wanting more, while also appreciating what you already have.About Woody Allenâs early lifeHeywood âWoodyâ Allen (born Allan Stewart Konigsberg) was born in Brooklyn, New York, on December 1, 1935. His mother worked as a bookkeeper, while his father was a waiter and also engraved jewelry. Woody had humble beginnings and was from a middle-class family. Over the years, the filmmaker and actor has been open about how his relationship with his parents was strained and that he did not connect well enough with them. As a child, he immersed himself in the arts to escape his turbulent childhood. This included reading comic books, listening to jazz radio, doing magic tricks, and playing the clarinet.From an early age, he was interested in filmmaking and studied the subject at NYU (from where he later dropped out after failing a class) and City College of New York. He also legally changed his name to Heywood Allen when he was 17 and started calling himself by the nickname, âWoody.âWoody Allenâs careerHe started in the industry writing for âThe Herb Shriner Show,' after which he also wrote for âThe Tonight Showâ and âCandid Camera.' He received his first Grammy nomination for his self-titled comedy album. He dabbled in Broadway, working on âDon't Drink the Waterâ and âPlay It Again, Sam.â He entered the film industry as a screenwriter with âWhat's New, Pussycat?â and the rest is history. Over the years, he has worked as a scriptwriter, filmmaker, director, and actor. His first time as a director came with âWhat's Up, Tiger Lily.'Over the course of his career in the entertainment industry, Allen has scored more than 75 writing credits, along with over 50 directing credits and 50 acting credits.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Prince William ‘blindsided’ by Harry, Meghan return as Kate fears new turmoil from royal feud: experts
articles.summary: Prince William was reportedly "blindsided" by the Sussexes' U.K. return, with royal experts saying he and Princess Catherine are concerned about the fallout.
articles.body: Prince William was reportedly "blindsided" by Prince Harry and Meghan Markle’s surprise decision to return to the U.K. with their children. Several royal experts told Fox News Digital that the Prince and Princess of Wales are "concerned" about the Duke and Duchess of Sussex returning for an extended period beginning this month. Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet are set to begin school there in September, People magazine reported. "Prince William was blindsided," Kinsey Schofield, host of YouTube’s "Kinsey Schofield Unfiltered," told Fox News Digital. PRINCE HARRY, MEGHAN MARKLE’S UK MOVE PUTS FRESH SPOTLIGHT ON THEIR EXPLOSIVE CLAIMS AGAINST ROYAL FAMILY "He had found Harry’s recent eagerness to publicly signal that he wanted to spend more time in Britain unusual, but that is very different from anticipating a full return. William now has to navigate a situation he did not create, did not ask for and, given the state of their relationship, almost certainly would not have chosen." Fox News Digital reached out to Kensington Palace for comment. In a statement shared with The New York Times, a spokesperson for the Sussexes said, "On the heels of a wonderful trip with family and friends this summer, Harry and Meghan have decided to spend an extended period in the U.K. this autumn. They are excited to have their children spend more time in the country that’s such an important part of their family’s story." The spokesperson confirmed that the couple’s businesses will remain unchanged and based in the U.S. Meghan and Harry will also keep their home in California. British broadcaster and photographer Helena Chard told Fox News Digital that the Waleses are "feeling uneasy" about facing another chapter in the "endless Sussex soap opera." WATCH: PRINCE WILLIAM UNLIKELY TO RECONCILE WITH PRINCE HARRY SOON: EXPERT "It’s about broken trust," Chard explained. "Prince William is said to feel that Harry and Meghan have spent years attacking the institution, then monetizing their grievances through a very lucrative media operation. From his view, it’s an ongoing campaign for maximum impact and self-gain. He’s not going to fuel it, and he’s not going to endorse behavior he sees as damaging." William and Kate were seen arriving in Scotland on Thursday, where they’ll spend time with King Charles at Balmoral Castle. The royal family has spent summers at the Scottish estate since the reign of Queen Victoria, with family members traditionally hunting, fishing and horseback riding there. The king learned about Harry and Meghan’s move three days before it was made public, according to reports. "Prince William, along with Catherine, is currently at Balmoral Castle visiting the king," royal broadcaster Neil Sean told Fox News Digital. "Harry and Meghan have, so far, not been invited to visit the king privately while on a holiday. This will not happen while William is there. I’ve been told he has no desire to connect on any level with his younger brother and simply has no time for [Meghan]." Fox News Digital reached out to Archewell, which handles the offices of the Duke and Duchess of Sussex, for comment. The Daily Mail reported that the king and his heir held a "Sussex Summit" following the announcement. A source told the outlet that the Prince and Princess of Wales "have no interest in engaging with anything Harry and Meghan do or say." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "Things are projected to be tense at Balmoral," British royal expert Hilary Fordwich told Fox News Digital. "... Princess Catherine is particularly guarded given how deeply hurt she was by both of them. Both she and Prince William are very determined to maintain their own family stability and remain focused on duty with their royal roles paramount." Several royal experts previously told Fox News Digital that William and Harry haven’t been on speaking terms since at least 2022. "My sources have described genuine concern within the Wales camp," Schofield said. "I don’t think Prince William and Princess Catherine are sitting at Balmoral panicking about Harry and Meghan returning, but they are understandably apprehensive about what their return could bring. The last several years have taught them that private family tensions have a habit of becoming very public." "The concern isn’t simply that Harry and Meghan will be geographically closer," Schofield continued. "It’s the unpredictability that comes with the Sussexes. There have been interviews, books, documentaries and very personal allegations about members of the royal family. … My sources tell me the Wales camp has not forgotten the hostility directed at them after some of Harry and Meghan’s previous public accusations." Schofield said unnamed sources told her Kate is also unsettled by the news. "My sources tell me that Catherine does not want to revisit that chapter of her life," Schofield explained. "She has endured very personal allegations, an enormous amount of public scrutiny and a difficult few years. My understanding has always been that her priority is Prince William, their children and the future." LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS "Meghan returning to Britain doesn’t mean Catherine suddenly has an obligation to reopen a relationship that has caused considerable hurt," she said. "Catherine can wish Harry and Meghan well without wanting them back inside her private life. ... The idea of resurrecting the ‘Fab Four’ is fantasy. Too much has happened, and too much has been lost." The Sussexes are expected to live at a private, nonroyal residence outside London, The Associated Press reported. They won’t resume their royal duties, which they gave up in 2020. The couple’s return to the U.K. comes as the king continues treatment for an undisclosed form of cancer diagnosed in 2024. In 2025, Harry said he didn’t know "how much longer my father has" and expressed a desire for his children to get to know their grandfather. Last month, the king met with Harry, Meghan and their children at Highgrove House. Vanity Fair royal correspondent Katie Nicholl reported at the time that, according to sources, "not even the Prince and Princess of Wales were made aware that the meeting was taking place." "The Sussexes played a blinder with the king welcoming them, having not told him last month of a plan they have had for ages as their children will soon be in school," royal expert Richard Fitzwilliams told Fox News Digital. The move is understood to have come together relatively quickly, as Harry and Meghan waited to learn whether their children had been accepted to the private school they applied to. PUT YOUR ENTERTAINMENT KNOWLEDGE TO THE TEST AND SEE HOW YOU SCORE "Since the brothers haven’t spoken in years, the imminent arrival of the Sussexes places William and Catherine in a pressured and difficult situation," said Fitzwilliams. "William is reportedly furious. But what is essential is that the king accepts that the Waleses and their children are the future of the monarchy." Schofield doesn’t believe reconciliation between the brothers is likely, at least anytime soon. "Geography cannot repair a relationship where trust has been so badly damaged," she said. "Harry’s return could make that estrangement more obvious because people will inevitably ask why two brothers living in the same country still aren’t seeing one another. ... William and Catherine could suddenly find themselves under public pressure to perform a reconciliation that probably doesn’t exist behind closed doors." CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP "... William may have reached the conclusion that distance is healthier than reconciliation, and he is entitled to make that decision," Schofield said. "The realistic goal at this stage probably isn’t friendship [with Harry]. I would argue it’s peaceful coexistence for the sake of their father. ... Harry and Meghan moving back to Britain creates proximity, not reconciliation. They can buy a house near London. They cannot buy back trust."

articles.title: Sonam Kapoor REACTS to notices issued to 722 Mumbai auto and taxi drivers over Marathi language test
articles.summary: Amid the ongoing row over Maharashtra's new rule making Marathi mandatory for commercial vehicle drivers, actress Sonam Kapoor has reacted to the cont.
articles.body: Amid the ongoing row over Maharashtra's new rule making Marathi mandatory for commercial vehicle drivers, actress Sonam Kapoor has reacted to the controversy on social media. Her response comes as transport officials continue assessing drivers across Mumbai and the surrounding region, with hundreds found unable to speak the language. Let's learn more about it.Sonam Kapoor's reactionReacting to the development, Sonam Kapoor commented on a post by a journalist, simply writing, "Huh."What the transport assessment foundSince August 20, transport officials have assessed 5,211 drivers, including 3,942 across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. Among those checked in the MMR, 722 drivers were found unable to speak Marathi and were subsequently issued notices. The Maharashtra State Transport Department had set August 15 as the deadline for drivers to learn Marathi after making knowledge of the language mandatory.Drivers go on strikeMumbai autorickshaw drivers began a three-day strike on Monday to oppose the government's rule, saying it could increase their financial burden, especially for those with limited formal education. Protesters also blocked traffic on Kandivali Link Road, raising concerns over the language requirement and penalties for non-compliance. Several drivers said older members of the community were finding it difficult to learn Marathi within the given deadline.What's next for Sonam Kapoor?Away from the controversy, Sonam Kapoor is yet to return to the big screen. She married Anand Ahuja in 2018 and welcomed their first son, Vayu, in August 2022, followed by their second son, Rudralokh, on March 29. The actress' last film was 'Blind' in 2023, and she was earlier expected to star in the screen adaptation of 'Battle For Bittora'.'Blind' was backed by Sujoy Ghosh and also featured Purab Kohli, Vinay Pathak and Lillete Dubey in supporting roles. It was released on July 7, 2023.She recently made a public appearance at cousin Anshula Kapoor's wedding on July 6 in Mumbai.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Kamal Haasan hails Vijay's TN Government for Bharathiraja memorial: âGratitude rendered in the fullness of timeâ
articles.summary: A major tribute is set to come up in Theni district for one of Tamil cinemaâs most respected filmmakers, Bharathiraja. The Tamil Nadu Government has a.
articles.body: A major tribute is set to come up in Theni district for one of Tamil cinemaâs most respected filmmakers, Bharathiraja. The Tamil Nadu Government has announced plans to build a memorial hall in his birthplace, complete with a bronze statue. The announcement has now received appreciation from actor and Rajya Sabha MP Kamal Haasan, who praised the government for recognising the directorâs contribution to Tamil cinema. The proposed memorial is being seen as a fitting tribute to a filmmaker who brought the lives, emotions and landscapes of rural Tamil Nadu to the screen.Kamal Haasan hails TN governmentâs Bharathiraja memorial planKamal Haasan took to X to welcome the Tamil Nadu Governmentâs decision. He expressed his gratitude for honouring Bharathiraja in the land where the filmmaker was born. âMy heartfelt congratulations to the Tamil Nadu government for announcing that a memorial hall will be established in the very soil of his birth for director Bharathiraja, who captured the scent of the earth on screen. This is a gratitude rendered in the fullness of time,â Kamal Haasan said in his post. His statement highlighted the deep influence Bharathiraja had on Tamil cinema and the importance of remembering artists who changed the way stories were told on screen.Bharathiraja memorial hall to come up in Theni at Rs 2.5 croreThe memorial was announced in the Tamil Nadu Assembly by Minister Rajmohan during the demands for grants for the School Education, Tamil Development, and Information and Publicity departments. According to the announcement, the memorial hall will be built in Theni district at an estimated cost of Rs 2.5 crore. A bronze statue of Bharathiraja will also be installed as part of the project. The filmmaker, who passed away on June 10 after a prolonged period of health issues, leaves behind a remarkable body of work spanning nearly five decades. He was more than a director, mentoring a number of actors and filmmakers who went on to become successful themselves.Bharathirajaâs legacy and Kamal Haasanâs upcoming filmsBharathiraja entered Tamil cinema as a director with '16 Vayathinile' in 1977 and went on to make films such as âKizhake Pogum Rail,â âSigappu Rojakkal,â âAlaigal Oivathillai,â âKaadhal Oviyamâ and âMudhal Mariyathai.â His work brought a strong sense of realism and rural life to mainstream Tamil cinema. His final directorial contribution was the âParavai Kootil Vaazhum Maangalâ segment in âModern Love Chennai.âMeanwhile, Kamal Haasan remains active on several projects as an actor and producer. He is associated with Sivakarthikeyanâs âSeyonâ and Rajinikanthâs âDharman,â while his collaboration with Anbariv is currently on hold. He is also expected to work on âKalki 2898 ADâ and a reunion project with Rajinikanth and Nelson. The proposed memorial ensures that Bharathirajaâs contribution will continue to be remembered in the very place where his journey began.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Kate Hudson to produce How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days sequel, 23 years on
articles.summary: Hudson and Matthew McConaughey, her co-star from the 2003 rom-com, could be reunited for the sequel.
articles.body:
A sequel to How to Lose a Guy In 10 Days is in development, more than 20 years after the original hit rom-com was released, with original star Kate Hudson set to produce.

Work on the film is in the "very early days", with sources telling US media , external that both Hudson, 47, and Matthew McConaughey, 56, could reprise their roles from the first film.

In the original, Hudson played a magazine journalist called Andie who researches an article about modern dating. She convinces her boss she can get a man, Benjamin (McConaughey), to leave her in 10 days. Meanwhile, Benjamin bets his boss he can make any woman fall for him, with Andie his target.

Hudson will produce the sequel alongside Stacey Sher, who is behind hits such as Pulp Fiction and Matilda.

The movie grossed nearly $180m worldwide at the box office at the time.

The yellow silk Carolina Herrera dress Hudson wore near the end of the film also became a much talked-about piece of modern cinema fashion.

The star's most recent film role was in 2025's Song Sung Blue, which earned her a second Oscar nomination, following her first nod for Almost Famous back in 2001.

McConaughey's films include Dallas Buyer's Club, which won him an Oscar in 2014, The Wedding Planner and Magic Mike. He also appeared in 2008 movie Fool's Gold alongside Hudson.

Representatives for Hudson and McConaughey have been contacted for comment.

The new film would be the latest in a trend for nostalgic sequels in Hollywood, following The Devil Wears Prada 2 - which came 20 years after the original and also featured a magazine employee called Andy (played by Anne Hathaway).

In 2024, McConaughey told People magazine about his first meeting with Hudson before filming How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days.

"Immediately, we were comfortable with each other, and we jacked with each other, and we busted each other's chops, and we laughed a lot," he recalled.

"There was a bit of rock and roll exchange, like, 'Oh, this could be some heavyweight fun.' And I think that's why I was cast, and that's why, for whatever extent, it worked."

articles.title: 'Naagzilla' actor Kartik Aaryan joins hands for Sandeep Modi's suspense thriller
articles.summary: After their earlier period action drama was shelved, Dharma Productions is once again joining forces with Kartik Aaryan and director Sandeep Modi for .
articles.body: After their earlier period action drama was shelved, Dharma Productions is once again joining forces with Kartik Aaryan and director Sandeep Modi for a new project.According to Bollywood Hungama, the team is reuniting for a new, high-concept action thriller that will begin filming early next year. Details of the project are currently under wraps, but the report describes the film as a distinctive thriller blending action, romance, and suspense. It will feature Kartik in a role markedly different from what he has played so far.âKaran Johar, Sandeep Modi and Kartik Aaryan have been discussing various projects after their patriotic action film couldn't materialize. They recently zeroed in on this story that will present Kartik in the most commercial yet distinctly different action avatar. Modi is currently putting the finishing touches on his script and will begin pre-production by the end of this year,â the report added.The upcoming project will be Kartik Aaryanâs third collaboration with Dharma Productions, after last yearâs romantic comedy 'Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri' and the upcoming fantasy comedy 'Naagzilla', which is scheduled to release around Valentineâs Day next year.For Sandeep Modi, the film will be his first Hindi theatrical directorial project. He previously made his directorial debut with the 2019 Marathi slice-of-life film 'Chumbak', starring Swanand Kirkire.Modi was earlier supposed to direct Kartik in a period action drama for Dharma Productions. Announced in November 2023, the film was expected to go on floors in 2024 and release during the Independence Day weekend in 2025. However, the project did not move ahead as the makers could not secure the life rights of the real-life person on whom Kartikâs character was based. The rising budget also reportedly made the film difficult for the production house to take forward.Meanwhile, Kartik has a busy lineup of films. He has completed shooting for Mrigdeep Singh Lambaâs 'Naagzilla', while Anurag Basuâs musical romance and Kabir Khanâs sports drama are currently in production. He is also set to begin Shimit Aminâs Captain India in September. Kartik is expected to start work on Sandeep Modiâs film after completing these commitments.Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!

articles.title: 'Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' teaser: Sidharth Malhotra, Tamannaah Bhatia's intense first glimpse hints at Goddess Durga connection ahead of September 25 release
articles.summary: Sidharth Malhotra's 'Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' has faced several delays, but the wait is finally over as the makers have unveiled the film's first .
articles.body: Sidharth Malhotra's 'Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' has faced several delays, but the wait is finally over as the makers have unveiled the film's first teaser along with its new release date. The short glimpse gave the audience enough visuals to root for the mythological drama. Let's learn more about the teaser here.What the teaser of Sidharth Malhotra's 'Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' revealsThe teaser opens with the introduction of a mysterious forrest, one that nobody who enters at night has ever returned from, as a dark force is said to lurk within it. However, fate leads Sidharth Malhotra's character into the forrest, and the background score adds intensity to his on-screen action sequences. In the teaser, Sidharth is heard saying, "Mujhe yeh ajeeb se cheeze dikhayi de rahi hai unn sab ka matlab kya hai? Kon kar raha hai yeh? (Iâm seeing these strange things. What do they mean? Who is doing this?)"Soon after, Tamannaah Bhatia's character appears and tells Sidharth that he shares a deep connection with the forrest. Towards the end, Sidharth's character hints at a divine power protecting the forrest, one whose mount is a tiger, pointing towards Goddess Durga.New release date announcedThe teaser also confirmed that 'Vvaan: Force of the Forrest' will now hit theatres on September 25, 2026. The makers have also announced that a second teaser will be released soon, building further anticipation for the film.More about 'Vvaan: Force Of The Forrest'Directed by Deepak Kumar Mishra, the film stars Sidharth Malhotra, Tamannaah Bhatia, Sunil Grover, Maniesh Paul, Shweta Tiwari, and Anup Soni in key roles. The music has been composed by Vishal Mishra, Amit Trivedi, Tanishk Bagchi, and Sam C.S.With its mythological premise and an ensemble cast, Vvaan: Force of the Forrest is set to arrive in cinemas on September 25, 2026.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.body:
After a real chick flick drought in recent years, fans of the genre are being treated to a whole slate of 2000s romantic-comedy sequels. The latest? The iconic How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days . Paramount Pictures is in early development on a follow-up to the 2003 movie, a source close to the project has confirmed to Deadline .

Hudson is producing alongside Stacey Sher, while Paramount and the filmmakers hope that Hudson and Matthew McConaughey will reprise their roles. However, no cast members are attached, and the project is still seeking a screenwriter, according to reports.

In the original movie, magazine writer Andie Anderson (Hudson) dates advertising executive Ben Barry (McConaughey) for an article about how to drive a man away in 10 days, unaware that he has bet he can make her fall in love with him in the same period. As is the rom-com way, they're bound for love, and their competing schemes become complicated when real feelings develop.

The film was a big hit, grossing over $178 million globally against a reported $50 million budget. Critics were less enthusiastic, with the film currently holding a 42% rating on Rotten Tomatoes , but audiences responded far more favorably. McConaughey said on the Happy Sad Confused podcast that it's the film that provides him with the most residual income.

"I think it's probably my favorite rom-com I've done, and a lot of people love that rom-com," McConaughey told host Josh Horowitz earlier this month . "And it still pays the best mailbox money of any film I've ever done. By far. By lengths."

No release date has been announced for the How to Lose a Guy in 10 Days sequel — and it remains to be seen whether Andie and Ben invested in a second "love fern" and managed to keep it alive — but several other 2000s rom-com revivals are also being developed or discussed.

A third installment (after 2004's The Princess Diaries: Royal Engagement ) is in development, with Anne Hathaway returning as teen-turned-princess Mia Thermopolis. Whether Chris Pine, Héctor Elizondo and Heather Matarazzo reprise their roles remains to be seen, but we know for certain that Julie Andrews won't be back .

A follow-up to the soccer film that gave Keira Knightley her breakthrough role is also in development, with the original film's cowriter and director, Gurinder Chadha, working on a sequel . It's unknown whether Knightley or her colead, Parminder Nagra (who played Jesminder "Jess" Bhamra), will return — it all hinges on the strength of the script, Chadha told Deadline last year.

A tale of adolescence, adulthood and what's really important in life, this Jennifer Garner classic had viewers joining in the "Thriller" dance and wanting Mark Ruffalo as their boyfriend (that hasn't changed). Earlier this summer, Netflix announced a reimagining of the movie is coming , with People We Meet on Vacation 's Emily Bader and The Perks of Being a Wallflower's Logan Lerman leading a new cast. Garner is on board as an executive producer, and while she and original costar Judy Greer have also been photographed filming scenes for the project, the exact nature of their roles hasn't been confirmed.

A festive favorite, The Holiday 's star-studded ensemble included Cameron Diaz, Kate Winslet, Jude Law and Jack Black. Last year, it was announced that Apple TV+ has a limited series adaptation in the works, but none of the original cast or Nancy Meyers, who wrote and directed the original, are said to be involved. Instead, the revival will use the same plot: An American woman and a British woman swap homes and lives for the holidays, ultimately finding love.

This high school revenge comedy starred some of the biggest names of the moment: Jesse Metcalfe, Sophia Bush, Ashanti, Arielle Kebbel, Penn Badgley and Brittany Snow. A sequel was first talked about in 2024 , when Kebbel said "there is a script" that "does involve all the OG cast," but in February, Kebbel revealed during a podcast interview that the project, which she was developing and producing, is "on pause for now."

During a hiatus from Grey's Anatomy , Katherine Heigl filmed her lead role in 27 Dresses as Jane, who was a bridesmaid in 27 weddings while quietly longing for love herself. In May 2025, Heigl said she was "in talks" about a sequel but added that it would "have to be done right." Her love interest in the movie, James Marsden, confirmed he's open to reprising his role too. "That movie weirdly has legs that I'm not sure I anticipated it having," Marsden told E! News in 2023. "Just a fanbase that people — when they talk about romantic comedies — you don't really see too many of those made nowadays."

articles.title: Jennifer Love Hewitt can't stop dancing to Jamie Miller's viral hit 'Babydoll.' She's not alone.
articles.summary: The Welsh singer's catchy new song has attracted some famous fans — and they're helping him turn a TikTok dance into a viral moment.
articles.body:
There are only so many times a singer can post himself dancing to the same song before people start scrolling past. Jamie Miller seems to have found a way to fix that: by bringing in celebrity dance partners.

The Welsh singer has been promoting his infectious new song, "Babydoll," on TikTok and Instagram by two-stepping to the track in video after video. Lately, though, the people dancing alongside him have gotten a lot more recognizable. Jennifer Love Hewitt was the first famous face to join him. Dancing With the Stars ' Julianne Hough then followed, as did Antonio Cipriano , one of the breakout stars of Prime Video's series Off Campus .

Love Hewitt, in particular, really got into "Babydoll," using it in several TikToks and posting a video of herself playing it on the piano. "Playing around with it makes me smile," she wrote in the Aug. 12 post, thanking Miller for the song. Just days later, she was dancing alongside him , with Miller dubbing her "the most iconic babydoll there is."

The upbeat track was released Aug. 7, although Miller had been teasing it by posting snippets since late July. Now, each new "Babydoll" video comes with a question: Who will Miller get to join him next? Viral dances can come and go quickly, but rotating cameos give the same song a reason to keep popping up on people's feeds: it's the ideal formula for keeping a viral moment going.

Singer Role Model pulled off something similar with his track "Sally, When the Wine Runs Out," bringing a different "Sally" onstage during performances. Celebrities including Natalie Portman, Olivia Rodrigo and Charli xcx all took a turn, and clips of the cameos routinely went viral. Finding out who Sally would be became part of the attraction.

Sabrina Carpenter put her spin on the celebrity reveal during her Short n' Sweet tour, jokingly "arresting" famous faces for "being too hot" before singing "Juno." Millie Bobby Brown, Gigi Hadid and Salma Hayek were among those who got cuffed.

For anyone just discovering Miller through "Babydoll," he's been around for a while. The 28-year-old appeared on The Voice U.K. in 2017, where he competed on Jennifer Hudson's team and finished third. He released his debut album, titled Long Way Home , in 2024, but it did not chart on the Billboard 200.

Earlier this year, he signed with Republic Records , which is home to many of pop's biggest names, including Taylor Swift, Ariana Grande and the Weeknd. He has a sizable social media fanbase, including 4.1 million followers on TikTok and 1.2 million on Instagram — but "Babydoll" has put a new level of attention on the singer.

Love Hewitt has been posting about "Babydoll" enough that people have started wondering if she's on the record company's payroll. "People have asked me, 'Why are you putting it in all of your videos, besides the fact that it's addicting? Why are you pushing this song so much? Do you work for his record company?'" she said in a TikTok posted Aug. 23.

Love Hewitt clarified that she didn't work for his record company and said she first heard "Babydoll" on a day that "was not great." "Music finds you when you really need it," she said, and the song changed her mood: "The day was instantly better, more manageable, full of light."

Then she got to know Miller. "He is light. He is magic," the actor said. The first time they met in person was when they filmed their video together. Love Hewitt is clearly rooting for him now. "He is such a pure, kind, good human, who has worked so hard for this moment," she said. "We are all collectively gathering around him, rooting for him, becoming his magical, positive light army in the world."

How long the "Babydoll" moment lasts is anyone's guess. But for now, Miller has something plenty of singers would envy: a growing audience waiting to see what happens next.

articles.title: Kuku Kohli, Aruna Irani's husband and 'Phool Aur Kaante' director, passes away at 77 after suffering cardiac arrest
articles.summary: Veteran filmmaker Kuku Kohli, best known for launching Ajay Devgnâs career with Phool Aur Kaante, has passed away at the age of 77. He suffered a card.
articles.body: Veteran filmmaker Kuku Kohli, best known for launching Ajay Devgnâs career with Phool Aur Kaante, has passed away at the age of 77. He suffered a cardiac arrest on Tuesday evening. His wife, actress Aruna Iraniâs spokesperson, has confirmed the news to ETimes.Since Aruna Irani was not in a state of mind to speak, her spokesperson shared details about what had happened.According to the spokesperson, Kuku Kohli felt restless on Monday night and suffered a mild heart attack. He was admitted to Kokilaben Hospital that same night, where he underwent an angioplasty. Everything appeared to be normal after the procedure. However, on Tuesday at around 5:15 pm, he suffered a massive cardiac arrest.Meanwhile, Aruna was on a call with him and exchanging messages, and the two were reportedly in a playful mood. He even told her, âLetâs not go overboard.â Shortly afterwards, however, he began showing signs that something was wrong. After some time, he stopped responding.The final rites of veteran filmmaker Kuku Kohli will take place on Wednesday, August 26, at Oshiwara Crematorium in Andheri West. His funeral procession will leave his residence at Green Acres, Lokhandwala Complex, Andheri West, at 10 am.Who was Kuku Kohli?Born Avtar Kohli on June 4, 1949, in Peshawar, Kuku Kohli was a director, writer, editor and screenwriter who spent more than three decades in the Indian film industry. Early in his career, he worked closely with legendary filmmaker Raj Kapoor, assisting him on films including Bobby, Prem Rog and Satyam Shivam Sundaram, where he honed his craft.He later served as second-unit director on Betaab, the film that launched Sunny Deol and Amrita Singh, and subsequently worked on Arjun, starring Sunny Deol and Dimple Kapadia.His biggest breakthrough came with Phool Aur Kaante in 1991, which marked Ajay Devgnâs debut as a leading actor and went on to achieve diamond jubilee status at the box office.A career spanning several hitsFollowing the success of Phool Aur Kaante, Kohli went on to direct several notable films, including Kohraam, starring Dharmendra, and Suhaag, featuring Ajay Devgn, Akshay Kumar and Karisma Kapoor.He also directed Haqeeqat, starring Ajay Devgn, Tabu and Amrish Puri. The film received seven nominations, including a Best Director nomination.His other works included Zulmi, starring Akshay Kumar and Twinkle Khanna, and Anari No. 1, which he co-produced with his wife.Kuku Kohliâs personal lifeKuku Kohli married veteran actress Aruna Irani in 1990. The couple reportedly did not have children together. This was Kohliâs second marriage, and he had two daughters from his first marriage to Rita Kohli.His passing marks the end of an influential chapter in Bollywoodâs commercial cinema of the 1990s, an era he helped shape through his collaborations with several leading stars of the time.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Jordi Cruz, chef, desvela la receta del salmorejo perfecto con un toque secreto: "Pequeños detalles marcan toda la diferencia"
articles.standfirst: El experimentado cocinero enumera las claves para conseguir un óptimo resultado de este clásico del verano
articles.summary: El experimentado cocinero enumera las claves para conseguir un óptimo resultado de este clásico del verano
articles.body: El periodo estival empieza a llegar a su fin, pero aún queda tiempo para elaborar las últimas recetas de los clásicos de este tiempo. El rey, por encima de todos, es el salmorejo. Jordi Cruz, chef y jurado de ‘MasterChef’, ha compartido en sus redes sociales los pasos que hay que seguir para conseguir el salmorejo perfecto con una receta “sencilla” y con “pocos ingredientes”. Lo primero que deja claro es que su salmorejo no lleva pimiento y tampoco vinagre, aunque matiza que esto es “un toque personal”. Para empezar con un buen pie en la elaboración, debemos procurar que “todos los ingredientes estén muy fríos antes de empezar”. Incluso, recomienda que puedes dejar el tomate cortado unos 20 minutos en el congelador. Después, hay que preparar la base del plato: “Tritura el tomate, el pimiento rojo (si decides utilizarlo) y el ajo sin germen hasta obtener una mezcla completamente fina”. Aunque hay personas que prefieren no añadir pan, Cruz sí lo incluye en su receta. Además, puntualiza que sea del “día anterior”. También se debe añadir en este momento la sal. “Con la trituradora en marcha, añade el aceite de oliva virgen extra poco a poco, en forma de hilo, hasta obtener una crema muy fina y sedosa”, apunta. También es gusto personal pasarlo por un colador, para eliminar posibles pieles o semillas y conseguir una textura todavía más elegante, antes de servirlo en la mesa. Por último, Jordi Cruz comparte un pequeño detalle para que la receta sea aún más perfecta y equilibrada: “Si utilizas pimiento rojo, aprovecha únicamente la carne y evita las semillas y las partes blancas del interior. Aporta un ligero dulzor y un extra de sabor sin alterar la receta”.

articles.title: Jennifer Garner says she 'panicked' about financial stability after divorce from Ben Affleck
articles.summary: Jennifer Garner reveals she "panicked" about finances after her split from Ben Affleck, realizing she needed to become a serious earner for her kids.
articles.body: Jennifer Garner once "panicked" about her financial stability shortly after her marriage to Ben Affleck came to an end. During an episode of the "Aspire with Emma Grede" podcast, Garner — who shares three children with Affleck — opened up about her past fear that she would no longer be able to financially support herself and her children post-divorce and explained how she pushed through.  "I panicked when I was first out of my marriage and realized I had taken such a step back in my work," said Garner. "Suddenly I realized I don't know how long I'll be able to work. This isn't a career that's like, 'Hey, you're 60, you're 55, you're 43, come on, let's pay you more than you've ever made.' You know what I mean? That's not been traditionally the role. I was suddenly like, 'Wait a minute, I have to take care of myself, I have to take care of these kids. So what is it going to be?'" JENNIE GARTH ADMITS ‘SCARY’ FINANCIAL SPIRAL AFTER ‘90210’ FAME Garner said this was the time in her life where she couldn't pick up and leave for months at a time for a movie shoot. She had to be in Los Angeles for her children. "I can't leave these kids for six months at a time," she said. "I would love to. I love going on location, but it's not this time in my career." ‘THE OFFICE’ STAR JENNA FISCHER EXPOSES THE GRUELING REALITY THAT FORCED HER OFF TV Affleck and Garner met on the set of 2001's "Pearl Harbor," but didn't spark a romantic relationship until 2004, after starring alongside one another in the 2003 film "Daredevil." They married in 2005, but eventually called it quits in 2015. "I was so lucky to be able to luxuriate and working some and being home and being a mom a lot of time," Garner said. "I was really grateful for that opportunity. I got to kind of have the best of both worlds, so I can't really look back and complain about any of it … it is what it is." GET ENTERTAINMENT SCOOP DELIVERED RIGHT TO YOUR EMAIL BY CLICKING HERE "It's not like you can just unfamous yourself. Life is expensive, and you still have to figure out how you're going to live," she added. "Just because you're well known by people does not mean that there is some great living being provided for you, and it became very serious to me, very quickly as someone who has never given a lot of thought to money, like, 'Oh I need to be an earner here.'" LIKE WHAT YOU'RE READING? CLICK HERE FOR MORE ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Two years after her divorce, Garner became a co-founder of the organic children's food company, Once Upon A Farm. Earlier this year, the "Alias" actress opened up about the "upheaval" that consumed her and their three children amid her very public split from Affleck. "When my kids were little, I worked so little, and then we had such an upheaval in our family, that I really hardly worked for a long time," she told the outlet. While balancing her work and professional life, Garner said she learned there is beauty in imperfection. "You have to raise yourself at the same time. And just be so radically kind to yourself about how imperfect it is," she said of trying to navigate life as a working mom of three. "And that it is just going to be imperfect.
